mapper.update:
/* com.mtf.edumarine.mapper.UnifiedMapper.updateUnifiedApplicationPayStatus */ UPDATE application_unified
apply_status = #{applyStatus},
cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, cancel_dttm = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %T'),
refund_bank_code = #{refundBankCode},
refund_bank_name = #{refundBankName},
refund_bank_customer_name = #{refundBankCustomerName},
refund_bank_number = #{refundBankNumber},
final_regi_dttm = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %T')
WHERE seq = #{seq}
mapper.select: SELECT seq, gbn, gbn_depth FROM train WHERE del_yn = 'N' AND application_system_type = 'UNIFIED' ORDER BY gbn ASC, gbn_depth ASC

/* com.mtf.edumarine.mapper.UnifiedMapper.selectUnifiedApplicationSingle */ SELECT u.* , m.name AS memberName , m.id AS memberId , t.gbn AS trainName FROM application_unified u JOIN member m ON u.member_seq = m.seq JOIN train t ON u.train_seq = t.seq WHERE u.seq = #{seq}

/* com.mtf.edumarine.mapper.EdumarineMapper.selectApplicationUnifiedSingle */ SELECT u.seq , u.train_seq , u.member_seq , u.apply_status , u.region , u.participation_path , u.first_application_field , u.second_application_field , u.third_application_field , u.desired_education_time , u.experience_yn , u.recommend_person , u.top_clothes_size , u.bottom_clothes_size , u.shoes_size , u.grade_gbn , u.school_name , u.major , u.military_gbn , u.military_reason , u.disabled_gbn , u.job_support_gbn , u.tech_edu_gbn , u.tech_edu_name , u.apply_reason , u.tech_reason , u.activity_reason , u.plan_reason , u.etc_reason , u.know_path , u.know_path_reason , u.clothes_size , u.rc_birth_year , u.rc_birth_month , u.rc_birth_day , u.train_understand , u.train_understand_etc , u.boarder_gbn , u.apply_day , u.choice_date , u.cancel_dttm , u.cancel_reason , u.refund_bank_code , u.refund_bank_name , u.refund_bank_customer_name , u.refund_bank_number , u.del_yn , u.note , u.init_regi_pic , u.init_regi_dttm , u.final_regi_pic , u.final_regi_dttm , m.name AS memberName , m.id AS memberId , t.gbn AS trainName FROM application_unified u JOIN member m ON u.member_seq = m.seq JOIN train t ON u.train_seq = t.seq WHERE u.seq = #{seq}
mapper.update: /* com.mtf.edumarine.mapper.UnifiedMapper.updateTrainApplyCntMinus */ UPDATE train SET train_apply_cnt = CASE WHEN train_apply_cnt > 0 THEN train_apply_cnt - 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE seq = (SELECT train_seq FROM application_unified WHERE seq = #{seq})
/* com.mtf.edumarine.mapper.UnifiedMapper.updateTrainApplyCntPlus */ UPDATE train SET train_apply_cnt = train_apply_cnt + 1 WHERE seq = (SELECT train_seq FROM application_unified WHERE seq = #{seq})
